verdict.rationale: llama.cpp ships a built-in server (`llama serve`/llama-server) with an HTTP API and web UI that can serve models to other clients, as shown running Qwen models (gh-2, gh-3, gh-18). However, the evidence pack never documents specific LAN-binding/host-port configuration, authentication, or independent confirmation of successful multi-device network access, so the network-serving aspect is implied rather than directly evidenced. missing for 10: explicit docs/flags for binding to 0.0.0.0 or LAN IP, independent hands-on reports of accessing the server from a separate device on the network, and any network-security/access-control guidance.
